links.outcome: Raw verdict accuracy versus defect-free accuracy (correct verdict without prohibited shortcuts) across agentic systems
links.effect: Four-way accuracy spans 65.3-76.1%, but defect-free accuracy is 4.8-14.8 points lower and reorders the leaderboard, so raw accuracy overstates investigation quality.
links.quote: Defect-free accuracy, which credits a verdict only when correct and free of prohibited shortcuts, is 4.8-14.8 points lower and reorders the leaderboard.

unlisted_practices: Scoring claim-level evidence grounding and policy grounding of agent investigations
Process-adherence scoring with replayable logged tool traces
Defect-free accuracy metric that credits verdicts only when free of prohibited shortcuts
Separating missing-evidence from medical-ambiguity abstention verdicts

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLM agents on a new clinical audit benchmark (CliniCARE-Bench) examining evidence grounding, policy use, and abstention, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice.
